conceptSummary: Pollination helps many plants make seeds. Pollen moves from one flower part to another so a new plant can begin.
keyPoints: Flowers use pollen to make seeds.
Seeds can grow into new plants.

vocabulary.definition: A tiny powder made by flowers.
vocabulary.exampleSentence: Collect the pollen to complete the mission.
The bee is your pollinator ally.

vocabulary.definition: A plant starter that can grow.
vocabulary.exampleSentence: Unlock the seed to finish the quest.

quizQuestions.question: What is the mission item in pollination?
quizQuestions.explanation: Pollen is what moves during pollination.

quizQuestions.question: What does a pollinator carry?
quizQuestions.explanation: Pollinators can carry pollen between flowers.

quizQuestions.question: What can seeds become?
quizQuestions.explanation: Seeds can grow into new plants.

questObjective: Move pollen to the right flower so seeds can form.
